en:
## New Features

- Add an OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code + PKCE provider with user consent, project-scoped grants, Connected Apps management, refresh rotation, and immediate revocation.
- Add External API v1 for idempotent remote-device and narrator provisioning, bounded message access, credential rotation, and grant-owned resource isolation.
- Add an isolated OAuth narrator WebSocket with single-use tickets, live authorization checks, immediate revocation, strict frames, Origin controls, rate limits, and staged feature gates.
- Add a sandboxed plugin platform with manifest contributions, isolated processes, provider and tool integration, plugin UI panels, capability controls, signatures, SBOM validation, health monitoring, and lifecycle management.
- Add planned-update draining and recovery UI, plugin panel integration, and short-press/long-press queue send modes.

## Security

- Separate first-party Session APIs from OAuth-only external APIs and enforce the intersection of token, grant, client policy, project allow-list, resource ownership, and knowledge permissions.
- Restrict MCP server administration to admins and preserve secrets through explicit set/delete patches without returning secret values.
- Replace legacy broad OAuth defaults with fine-grained External API v1 scopes while retaining deprecated provisioning endpoints only for compatibility.

## Bug Fixes

- Drain in-flight Bash and subagent work before planned updates, restore narrator state after restart, and avoid terminating leased update work.
- Respect provider retry diagnostics, prevent plugin providers from shadowing built-in providers, and improve abort-time tool result draining.
- Preserve all release architectures in update metadata and fall back to full artifacts when an incremental patch is unavailable.
- Avoid re-importing quoted WeChat media as new attachments.

## Documentation

- Replace the obsolete Open API draft with the implemented OAuth 2.0, External API v1, WebSocket, security, error-handling, and legacy migration guide.
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 新增 OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code + PKCE 提供方，支持用户同意、项目级 grant、已连接应用管理、refresh 轮换和即时吊销。
- 新增 External API v1，支持远端设备与叙述者的幂等创建、有界消息读取、凭证轮换和 grant 级资源隔离。
- 新增独立 OAuth 叙述者 WebSocket，采用单次 ticket、实时授权复核、即时撤销、严格帧协议、Origin 控制、限流和分阶段功能开关。
- 新增沙箱化插件平台，覆盖 manifest contribution、独立进程、provider/tool 接入、插件 UI 面板、能力控制、签名、SBOM、健康监控和生命周期管理。
- 新增计划更新排空与恢复界面、插件面板接入，以及队列发送按钮短按/长按双模式。

## 安全

- 完全隔离第一方 Session API 与 OAuth 外部 API，并强制执行 token、grant、客户端策略、项目白名单、资源 ownership 和知识权限的交集。
- 将 MCP 服务器管理限制为管理员操作，并通过显式 set/delete 补丁安全保留密钥，不再返回密钥内容。
- 新建 OAuth 应用默认改用 External API v1 细粒度 scope，旧的宽泛 scope 仅保留给已废弃兼容端点。

## 修复

- 计划更新前等待进行中的 Bash 和子代理任务排空，重启后恢复叙述者状态，并避免误杀持有更新 lease 的任务。
- 尊重 provider 的重试诊断，防止插件 provider 抢占内置 provider，并改进中断时工具结果的有界排空。
- 修复更新元数据中不同架构产物互相覆盖的问题，并在无增量包时自动回退完整产物。
- 修复微信引用消息中的媒体被当作新附件重复导入的问题。

## 文档

- 将过时的开放 API 设计草案替换为已实现的 OAuth 2.0、External API v1、WebSocket、安全、错误处理和旧端点迁移指南。
